## About
Grand Auto Glass is an auto glass shop at 3855 W Grand Ave in Chicago. We repair and replace windshields and car windows, fix chips and leaks, replace door mirrors and tint windows. We work with both new and used auto glass, and we are a certified Llumar dealer for window tint.
Our crew has been with us a long time, and we like it that way. Give us a call before you come in so we can check whether your windshield or window is in stock.
Drivers have rated us 4.6 on Google across 394 reviews.

## Services
- Auto glass replacement: Replacement windshields and car windows for your vehicle.
- Windshield chip and leak repair: Repairs for chips and leaks in your windshield before a small problem spreads.
- Automotive window tinting: Window tint for your car, with name brands to choose from.
- Door mirror replacement: Replacement for broken or damaged door mirrors.

## FAQ
Q: Do you handle insurance claims?
A: Yes. We handle insurance claims for broken windshields and cracked glass.

Q: Should I call before coming in?
A: It helps. One reviewer suggested calling first to check whether your windshield or window is in stock.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, we are open Saturday from 8 AM to 5 PM. We are closed on Sunday.

Q: Which glass brands do you carry?
A: We offer Pilkington, PGW Auto Glass, Mygrant Glass and Majestic Auto Glass, and we also work with used auto glass.
